verdict.rationale: LibreChat's first-party MCP docs say it can connect to any tool or service that provides an MCP server, from file-system access and browsers to custom business tools. Servers can be declared in librechat.yaml or added and updated at runtime from the MCP Settings panel without a restart, and connected MCP servers appear in the agent builder's searchable tool library. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that MCP tool use works in practice.
